commands: set -eu; export JAVA_HOME="$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21)"; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "0fe28cc50c0cb2aab19af31aaf4a40a76aff3205"; echo '--- ADB ---'; adb devices -l; SERIALS=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}'); COUNT=$(printf '%s\n' "$SERIALS" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l | tr -d ' '); test "$COUNT" = "1"; SERIAL=$(printf '%s\n' "$SERIALS" | sed -n '1p'); echo "serial=$SERIAL"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.product.manufacturer; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.product.model; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.build.version.release; echo '--- BUILD ---'; ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug --stacktrace; APK=app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk; test -f "$APK"; echo '--- APK ---'; if command -v apkanalyzer >/dev/null 2>&1; then PKG=$(apkanalyzer manifest application-id "$APK"); else PKG=$(find "${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}" -name aapt -type f | sort -V | tail -1 | xargs -I{} {} dump badging "$APK" | sed -n "s/package: name='\([^']*\)'.*/\1/p"); fi; test -n "$PKG"; echo "package=$PKG"; echo '--- INSTALL ---'; adb -s "$SERIAL" install -r "$APK"; echo '--- LAUNCH ---'; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell monkey -p "$PKG" -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1 >/dev/null; sleep 2; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys package "$PKG" | grep -E 'versionName=|versionCode=' | head -5 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys activity activities | grep -E 'mResumedActivity|topResumedActivity' | head -5 || true; echo '--- UI ---'; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/blueeye-window.xml >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cat /sdcard/blueeye-window.xml 2>/dev/null | head -c 30000 || true
